scope: Interruptible Task policy, native atomic signal/wake operations and four-task serial deadlines under concurrent kernel work

observer.scope: Passive full-address CPU markers, POKEY timestamps and I-flag transitions between emulator microstates; no guest instructions/cycles added
observer.build_options: Same as toolchain/altirra-build.json, build/latency target AltirraBridgeServer
observer.resolution: I transitions sampled between CPU microstates, including RTI followed immediately by IRQ. 1/8 base-cycle timestamps at 8x; includes NMI/ROM/DMA elapsed time. Not a hardware worst-case guarantee.

commands: python3 tools/test_signal_concurrency.py --compiler-dir build/actionc --workload compute --workload yield --workload signals --workload sleep --workload mixed --count 4096 --require-deadline
python3 tools/test_signal_concurrency.py --compiler-dir build/actionc --mode raw --mode opt --workload yield --workload signals --workload mixed --count 65535 --require-deadline
execution_note: Signal suite executed as six atomic/IRQ-context cases plus eight disjoint batches. The complete expected case set is checked before publication. Commands above reproduce the same complete set without batching.

bank_zero.accounting: Complete reservations, including guards, alignment and unused capacity. Native atomic helpers and four COP scratch bytes fit existing stack/headroom reservations; no new DP or queue storage.

limits: Four public tasks plus idle in timing tests; eight-task functional capacity is separate from concurrent eight-task baud qualification.
Diagnostic generated TX pump with one completion signal per block; RAM buffers, RX, SIO protocol and DOS are not implemented.
Native entry/return, atomic transactions and caller-masked calls still mask IRQs. Arbitrary I=1 application calls and OS I/O/timer callbacks have no baud guarantee.
Per-byte worker delivery is not requalified by this change.
Pinned emulator measurements including NMI/ROM/DMA time are observed maxima, not a physical hardware worst-case guarantee.
Deliberately stalled IRQ/NMI race probes are excluded from timing acceptance.
Raw logs contain bridge credentials and stay uncommitted.
